Porsche 997.2 Turbo S.blurb: 997.2 Turbo S coupe, 2010-2013 - the owned-car benchmark.

world.label: 3,095 coupes
world.detail: 997.2 Turbo S coupes, MY2011-2013, worldwide. No North American coupe split survives: PCNA data put the North American total at 2,333 Turbo S of both bodies, and 222 of the MY2013 coupes. There was no 997.1 Turbo S; the '2,000' sometimes quoted was a launch-era figure the factory-archive count does not support.
world.src: Marc Bongers, Porsche Serienfahrzeuge (ex-Porsche archive); Streather

Acura NSX (NA2 manual).blurb: Pre-facelift NA2, 1997-2001, six-speed, coupe and targa.

na.label: 1,173 US manuals
na.detail: US-market NA2 six-speeds, 1997-2001 (309 / 230 / 215 incl. 51 Zanardi / 263 / 156 by year); 81 automatics on top, 1,254 in all. No worldwide NA2 or manual split is published - Honda's only worldwide figure is 18,734 NSXs of every kind, 1990-2005.
na.src: Ben Lin's US production data (NSX Prime chart)

Ferrari 360 (gated manual).blurb: Gated six-speed only - the F1 cars are a different market.

na.label: 1,139 US manuals
na.detail: US-market gated six-speeds: 469 Modena + 670 Spider, out of 4,199 US cars and 16,365 worldwide (Challenge Stradale excluded). No worldwide manual count is published. The f-register chassis list counts 2,115 manual Spiders worldwide (of 7,565) but has no manual split for coupes.

na.label: ~743 to the US
na.detail: US gated six-speed V10 coupes: 717 V10 (12 MY09, 208 MY10, 199 MY11, 212 MY12, 51 MY14, 35 MY15) + 26 V10 plus. Compiled from Audi of America data by R. N. Labas, who notes about 10 cars may sit in the wrong year. No worldwide manual count exists; Audi built just over 26,000 first-gen R8s of every kind.
na.src: R. N. Labas R8 V10 register (Audi of America data)

Corvette split-window (1963).blurb: 1963 coupe only - the one-year split rear window.

world.label: 10,594 built
world.detail: 1963 split-window coupes, body numbers 00001-10594. The 10,919 convertibles that made up the rest of the 21,513 total are excluded, as in the price data.

Volvo P1800 (1800 family).blurb: 1800 family incl. the ES shooting brake.

world.label: ~47,500 built
world.detail: 39,407 coupes (P1800 / 1800S / 1800E) + 8,077 1800ES, 1961-1973. The quoted total of 47,492 is 8 more than those parts sum to.

Porsche Singer 911.blurb: Singer-reimagined 964 - a different market to everything else here.

world.label: 300+ built, ongoing
world.detail: Singer completed its 300th reimagined 911 in February 2024 and is still building. No later total has been published. Every Singer is built on a 1989-94 964 and titled by that year, so all are past the 25-year line.

Ferrari 328 GTS/GTB.blurb: 328 GTB and GTS, 1986-1989 - the last of the carburettor-era shape.

world.label: 7,412 built
world.detail: 6,068 GTS + 1,344 GTB, 1985-1989. One chassis register puts the GTS lower (3,067-4,979); 6,068 is the figure 308-328.com and most references use.

Ferrari Dino 246 GT/GTS.blurb: 246 GT and GTS, 1969-1974 - the V6 junior Ferrari, badged Dino.

world.label: 3,761 built
world.detail: 2,487 GT (357 L + 506 M + 1,624 E series) + 1,274 GTS, 1969-1974. The f-register chassis list and Bonhams catalogue notes agree on 1,624 E-series GTs; the 3,569 on Wikipedia counts only 1,431.

Lotus Evora GT (2020-21).blurb: Final US Evora, 2020-2021 - supercharged V6, manual and auto.

na.label: 722 to the US
na.detail: 374 MY2020 + 348 MY2021 US cars, 535 of them manual. Owner-reported from Lotus Certificates of Provenance, not an official Lotus release. The Evora GT name was North America only, so this is effectively its whole production.

Lotus Emira V6 (2024-25).blurb: Supercharged Toyota V6, six-speed - the last analogue Lotus.

Ferrari 550 Maranello.blurb: 1996-2001 front-engined V12 coupe, gated six-speed - every one a manual.

world.label: 3,083 built
world.detail: 550 Maranello coupes, 1996-2001. The 448 Barchettas are counted separately and excluded here, as in the price data. A chassis register counts 3,735 including 33 WSR editions; RM Sotheby's catalogues use roughly 3,000-3,083.

Ferrari F355 Berlinetta (gated manual).blurb: Gated six-speed coupe, 1995-1999 - the F1 paddle cars are a different market.

world.label: ~3,822 built
world.detail: Gated-manual F355 Berlinettas, 1994-1999, worldwide: 3,931 manual chassis in the register less the 109 Challenge conversions. Another 1,049 were F1. Totals reconcile within ~2% of the 4,871 Berlinettas usually quoted.

Ferrari F355 GTS (gated manual).blurb: Targa-top GTS, gated six-speed, 1995-1999 - the lift-out roof, not the Spider.

world.label: ~2,003 built
world.detail: Gated-manual F355 GTS targas, 1994-1998, worldwide; another 526 were F1. Totals reconcile within ~2% of the 2,577 GTS usually quoted.
